exempt.tests/helpers/legacy-fixture.ts: Loads and fingerprints the legacy SQL fixtures, databases the retired positional runner built before any ORM schema existed.
exempt.tests/helpers/legacy-upgrade-suite.ts: Reads legacy databases before and after the legacy baseline adopts them; the bookkeeping tables it checks (schema_version, mikro_orm_migrations) are the subject.
exempt.tests/integration/legacy-upgrade-v244.te: Compares a v4.3.3 database column by column before and after the upgrade, through pragma_table_info, on a copy no ORM is bound to.
exempt.tests/unit/db/booked-night-reseat.test.t: Tests migration step 242, which reseats booked nights over the raw connection; the rows it seeds are the ones the step transforms before any repository runs.
exempt.tests/unit/db/dialect/sql-functions.test: Pins the SQL text and the engine result of every dialect function in src/db/dialect/sql-functions.ts; the raw statement is what is under test.
Compares PRAGMA table_info, foreign_key_list and index_list of the migrated schema against the entity metadata.
exempt.tests/unit/db/foreign-key-indexes.test.t: Reads PRAGMA foreign_key_list, index_list and index_info and EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN to prove every foreign key is indexed.
Seeds and reads a bare database for scripts/migrate-encryption.ts, which runs on the raw handle without the ORM.
exempt.tests/unit/db/nul-safe-sqlite-platform.t: Pins how the SQLite driver binds and returns the literals the platform has to escape (NUL, NaN, infinities).
exempt.tests/unit/db/place-regions-follow-place: Pins the place_regions trigger the migrations install, by raw UPDATEs on places and on databases built by the migrations alone.
Inspects the VACUUM INTO copy written before the migrator runs, a file no ORM is bound to.
exempt.tests/unit/db/restore-migrates-forward.t: Probes a restored database file before any ORM boots on it.
exempt.tests/unit/db/test-orm.test.ts: Proves the test ORM shares the raw handle it was given; the raw statements are the subject.
